# Forgehand 0.2.2

Forgehand 0.2.2 restores native lifecycle controls for repositories using `labelPolicy: null`. The released loader silently skipped those mappings: an inactive Issue carrying Keep Open, Manual Triage or No Auto-reply could still receive a stale warning, even though the local preview appeared to respect the control. The runtime now keeps the native mappings applicable, and preview uses the same loaded configuration. A repository with an explicit canonical label policy still retains its exact Issue/PR scopes.

**Existing adopters using `labelPolicy: null` should update their reviewed runtime pin to this release's exact commit**, including both the reusable-workflow reference and its runtime checkout reference. Keep the repository's existing policy and message templates; no canonical label catalogue needs to be added as a workaround. This release does not update caller pins, enable a consumer, change credentials or restore effects already delivered by an older runtime. The [maintenance guide](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/forgehand/blob/v0.2.2/docs/maintenance.md#installation-and-updates) explains the source-upgrade path.

Forgehand's repository-owned DiffDevil Action also verifies the Automaton identity before passing the writer token to DiffDevil. The self-adoption documentation now records the Action as the sole enabled size writer, qualified on an ordinary pull request; managed App execution remains suspended until it can load the repository-owned XL reply template. Dependabot-authored pull requests are not yet sized by this route. These are Forgehand's own adoption facts, not activation of the Action in other repositories.
